evidence.quote: Proof of sufficient English language proficiency for English-taught degree programmes
University entrance qualification obtained outside Germany: Further information can be found on the following page.

notes: Tuition: DAAD page states 'Tuition fees per semester None' and the HSRW living-costs page states 'At Rhein-Waal University of Applied Sciences, you do not pay tuition fees, as it is a state university in North Rhine-Westphalia.' This is an institution-wide statement and was not recorded as a tuition fact. Intakes: pages give only 'until 15 July' and 'Winter semester: 15 July' without a year and without stating that the deadline is for international/non-EU applicants specifically, so no intake fact was output.

note.fr: La plateforme uni-assist vérifie vos documents avant de les transmettre à l'université; vérifiez la procédure exacte sur uni-assist.
note.en: The uni-assist platform checks your documents before forwarding them to the university; check the exact procedure on uni-assist.

evidence.quote: Your documents will then be checked by uni-assist and, provided you meet the admission requirements, forwarded to Rhine-Waal University of Applied Sciences for a final decision and the issuance of a decision letter.

note.fr: Un stage de huit semaines doit être effectué avant le début du quatrième semestre.
note.en: An eight-week internship has to be completed before the start of the fourth semester.
